verdict.overall_conclusion: The adopted contract permits separate use-level adjudication in principle, but the current F3 v4 contract cannot be reinterpreted so that the .0125 count screen alone passes its named G2 use. Count/occupancy may remain report-only when timing is unavailable; a count-only positive use requires a separately frozen contract.

evidence.proposition: G2 is use-specific and only permits claims for the explicitly passed use; numerical_core is not an all-purpose qualification.
Every use must freeze its own task scale, time/quality scale, observables, aggregation, normalization, and over-budget handling; a separate count-only use would therefore need its own contract.
A failed use excludes only that use, while at least one common core use still needs real positive evidence; this is the YES for per-use adjudication in principle.

F3 v4 defines one comparison unit and one named saved-count-normalized-nearness-history-temporal-sensitivity use with count/category, first-entry, residence, return, and integrity metric families. The count rule is <=0.0125; timing is <=0.03 s; residence is <=0.075 s.

The positive scoped G2 candidate requires all fixed-cohort integrity, category, bracket, residence, return, and count screens, and its label is temporal sensitivity only. A count screen cannot independently satisfy this existing positive rule.

A frozen temporal/count failure remains a failed scoped G2 condition and an inconclusive/unavailable condition remains so; no denominator replacement, retiming, interpolation, threshold change, or anchor-only inference is allowed.

When the timing gate is unavailable, count/occupancy/residence metadata may be reported under temporal_timing_gate_unavailable_report_only, but positive_scoped_g2_candidate and other qualification claims are explicitly disallowed.

current_f3_candidate.reason: The v4 positive rule is conjunctive across all named metric families. The existing timing/residence negative or unavailable evidence therefore prevents the current named F3 temporal-sensitivity G2 candidate from passing even if a count screen is later within 0.0125.
current_f3_candidate.assets_disposition: retain existing products and count metadata as report-only/development evidence; do not erase or rewrite the negative evidence.

count_only_future_use.requirements: Freeze a separate named use contract specifying the count/occupancy estimand, fixed denominator and categories, completeness/unknown handling, comparison scope, threshold, and permitted claim. Do not reuse the v4 conjunctive G2 label by relabeling one metric family.
count_only_future_use.mass_boundary: This decision concerns the existing count-normalized occupancy screen only and does not use or reinterpret any mass result.

adjudication.comparison003_next_step_if_separately_co: A later single admitted child could extract the complete preexisting comparison003 count, timing, and residence outputs under their immutable contracts, preserving every negative/inconclusive status; no rerun, threshold change, crop, retime, interpolation, or new data product is authorized by this file.
